name: Plex Media Server
summary: Stream your movies, shows and music to the Plex apps on every TV and phone.
description:
Plex Media Server organises the movies, TV shows and music on this server and streams them to the Plex apps on smart TVs, streaming sticks, consoles, phones and the web, at home or away. It needs a free Plex account.

Before installing, sign in at https://www.plex.tv/claim and copy the claim code into the Plex claim code box: it links this server to your Plex account. Codes stop working after 4 minutes, so get one just before you click Install. Then open Plex, name the server and add libraries, for example /media/Movies and /media/TV. Plex only reads your Media folder.

To watch away from home, forward the Plex port on your router to this server. Hardware transcoding with the graphics chip needs a Plex Pass.

settings.label: Plex claim code
settings.help: From https://www.plex.tv/claim (starts with claim-). It expires 4 minutes after you get it. Once the server is linked it's no longer needed.

shares.name: MEDIA
shares.label: Media library
shares.help: The folder with your movies, shows and music. Plex only reads it. Inside Plex it appears as /media.
